Item 2: Advisory Vote on Executive Compensation

Our Board of Trustees increased the annual dividend rate by 5.2 percent for 2025 to $3.01 per share, exceeding the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Index companies' median dividend growth rate of 5.0 percent.
Our 2025 Trustee nominees include eight who have served on the Board for eight or fewer years.
All Trustees are elected annually by a majority vote of the common shares issued and outstanding.
All of the nominees are independent other than the Chief Executive Officer.
We have a Lead Independent Trustee and hold at least three independent Trustee meetings every year.
Each of our Trustees attended at least 75 percent of the aggregate number of Board and Committee meetings during 2025.
Trustees must retire at the Annual Meeting following their 75th birthday.
Deliver the majority of incentive compensation opportunity in long-term equity.
Maintain a broad financial and personal misconduct clawback policy relating to incentive compensation.
Tie 75 percent of long-term incentive compensation to performance and grant 100 percent of long-term incentive compensation in equity.
Maintain limited trading windows for Trustees and executives.
Include tax gross-ups in any new or materially amended executive compensation agreements.
Allow hedging, pledging or similar transactions by Trustees and executives.
Provide for liberal share recycling within long-term compensation grants.
